title: Dan-Lou tablets reduces inflammatory response via suppression of the MyD88/p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway in RAW 264.7 macrophages induced by ox-LDL.
authors: Li, Zhu; Cheng, Qi; Yu, Lu; He, Yuan-Yuan; Gao, Li-Na; Wang, Yue; Li, Lin; Cui, Yuan-Lu; Gao, Shan; Yu, Chun-Quan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹蒌片通过MyD88/p38 MAPK/NF-κB通路抑制巨噬细胞炎症反应，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL EVIDENCE: The anti-inflammatory effect of Dan-Lou tablets (DLT) have been reported; however, the signaling pathways involved and their role in foam cell formation remains unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of this study was to determine the molecular target and mechanism of DLT in the treatment of coronary heart disease (CHD), and investigate the role of DLT in inhibiting foam cell formation and the anti-inflammatory effects of RAW 264.7 macrophages. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study explored and elucidated the main active components, therapeutic targets, and pharmacological mechanisms of DLT treatment for CHD using network pharmacology. Secondly, the accuracy of the interaction of key active compounds with key proteins was verified by molecular docking analysis. Eight chemical compositions were determined from the ethanol extract of DLT (EEDL) by high-performance liquid chromatography. Finally, this study used EEDL intervention with oxidized low-density lipoprotein (ox-LDL) to induce RAW264.7 macrophages to verify the results of network pharmacology. RESULTS: According to network pharmacological analysis, 269 common targets of DLT and CHD were obtained from an online database, and 24 key targets were obtained from further analysis. GO enrichment and KEGG analyses were performed, mainly involving the cAMP, cGMP-PKG, MAPK, and NF-kappaB signaling pathways, and vascular smooth muscle contraction. Molecular docking showed that the active components in DLT docked well with MyD88, NF-kappaB, and p38 MAPK. The eight compounds from the EEDL have been identified as gallic acid, salvianolic acid, puerarin, daidzein, paeoniflorin, salvianolic acid B, cryptotanshinone, and tanshinone IIA with concentrations of 4.62, 4.76, 23.73, 34.24, 14.59, 21.69, 0.34, and 0.47 mug/mg, respectively. Further in vitro experiments showed that the levels of MyD88 and p-p38 MAPK in RAW 264.7 macrophages induced by ox-LDL increased noticeably. Stimulating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway increased the release of pro-flammatory factors (TNF-alpha and IL-1beta) and strengthened the inflammatory response (P < 0.05 or P < 0.01), while the levels of MyD88, p38 MAPK, NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta decreased after EEDL treatment (P < 0.05 or P < 0.01). CONCLUSION: The study demonstrated that the anti-inflammatory activity of the DLT intervention of ox-LDL-induced RAW 264.7 macrophages may involve the MyD88/p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学证据：丹蒌片（DLT）的抗炎作用已有报道；然而，所涉及的信号通路及其在泡沫细胞形成中的作用仍不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在确定DLT治疗冠心病（CHD）的分子靶点和机制，并探讨DLT在抑制泡沫细胞形成及RAW 264.7巨噬细胞抗炎作用中的角色。材料与方法：本研究通过网络药理学探索并阐明了DLT治疗CHD的主要活性成分、治疗靶点和药理机制。其次，通过分子对接分析验证了关键活性化合物与关键蛋白相互作用的准确性。采用高效液相色谱法从DLT乙醇提取物（EEDL）中测定了八种化学成分。最后，本研究使用EEDL干预氧化低密度脂蛋白（ox-LDL）诱导的RAW264.7巨噬细胞，以验证网络药理学的结果。结果：根据网络药理学分析，从在线数据库中获得DLT和CHD的269个共同靶点，进一步分析获得24个关键靶点。进行了GO富集和KEGG分析，主要涉及cAMP、cGMP-PKG、MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路，以及血管平滑肌收缩。分子对接显示，DLT中的活性成分与MyD88、NF-kappaB和p38 MAPK对接良好。EEDL中的八种化合物被鉴定为没食子酸、丹酚酸、葛根素、大豆苷元、芍药苷、丹酚酸B、隐丹参酮和丹参酮IIA，浓度分别为4.62、4.76、23.73、34.24、14.59、21.69、0.34和0.47微克/毫克。进一步的体外实验表明，ox-LDL诱导的RAW 264.7巨噬细胞中MyD88和p-p38 MAPK水平显著增加。刺激NF-kappaB信号通路增加了促炎因子（TNF-alpha和IL-1beta）的释放，并增强了炎症反应（P < 0.05或P < 0.01），而EEDL处理后MyD88、p38 MAPK、NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta的水平降低（P < 0.05或P < 0.01）。结论：研究表明，DLT干预ox-LDL诱导的RAW 264.7巨噬细胞的抗炎活性可能涉及MyD88/p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路。
